notes: Odoo's external API is RPC method dispatch over three documented transports, all modelled here: XML-RPC (POST /xmlrpc/2/common, /xmlrpc/2/object; text/xml bodies described as strings), JSON-RPC (POST /jsonrpc, /web/session/authenticate) and the 19.0 JSON-2 API (POST /json/2/{model}/{method}). The adaptor uses odoo-await, which speaks XML-RPC: it authenticates on /xmlrpc/2/common and sends all six operations (create, read, update, deleteRecord, searchRecord, searchReadRecord) as execute_kw on /xmlrpc/2/object. Until 2026-11-14 this spec held only the JSON-RPC pair, on the mistaken premise that OpenAPI cannot describe XML-RPC, so openfn-mocker's XML-RPC traffic matched no operation. BEST-EFFORT rather than complete because the callable models and methods are defined per database (each instance's /doc page) and cannot be enumerated in a public document; the transports themselves are fully covered.

attempts.note: Odoo 19 serves per-database model/method documentation at /doc, but it needs an authenticated instance and describes that database's models, not the transport.
External JSON-2 API: POST /json/2/<model>/<method>, bearer API key, error object.
